section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical methods used to analyze data from a single study examining the factor structure of the BAS-2 across women and men. The study employed exploratory factor analysis (EFA) with quartimax rotation, independent-samples t-tests to compare scores between genders, and bivariate correlations to examine associations between body appreciation, BMI, self-esteem, life satisfaction, and other variables.
